organization.positioning: Premium fair-chase hunting estate in the Waterberg, Limpopo, South Africa. PH-led plains and dangerous game where legally and ethically offered. Census-driven quarry roster, not a guaranteed species menu.

geography.publicLocationLine: Waterberg Biosphere · Thabazimbi area, Limpopo, South Africa
geography.gateDirectionsPolicy: Exact gate coordinates and directions are supplied when a booking is confirmed.
geography.travelNote: International hunters typically route via Johannesburg (OR Tambo). Drive times and shuttle details must stay verify-with-management.

accommodation.model: Four guest chalets only on the hunting camp. No separate main guest residence for hunters on camp.
accommodation.campWideCapacityApprox: Up to about 20 guests when all chalets are full
accommodation.bedding: Four single beds and one double bed per chalet
accommodation.bathroom: Showers, two basins, toilet per chalet

communalHub.name: Vark Kraal
communalHub.role: Communal bar, kitchen, lounge and dining

includes: Alcohol on estate under responsible service guidelines
catering.excludes: Metered hotel-style bar billing for included package scope

campFacilities: Outlook point for viewing and sundowners

onEstateActivities.scheduling: When the schedule allows. Not guaranteed every day without enquiry

huntingServices.primary: Fair-chase hunting under professional hunter (PH) field standards
huntingServices.quarryPolicy: Census-driven roster and quota. Availability is ecology-driven, not a static menu guarantee.
huntingServices.dangerousGame: Offered only where legally and ethically appropriate and under PH guidance

meatAndHides: Cold room for meat and perishables
fieldAndLogistics.valuables: On-site safe facilities for documents, cash, small electronics
fieldAndLogistics.shuttle: Optional shuttle service. Enquire when booking
fieldAndLogistics.rifleHire: Verify availability and terms with management
fieldAndLogistics.firearmImport: Temporary import (e.g. SAPS 520) and licences are the client's responsibility with their own agents

complianceAndTrust.p3ExemptionPermit: Estate references P3 Exemption Permit framework. Confirm current certificate and scope with management before any legal or marketing claim
complianceAndTrust.taxidermyAndExport: Estate does not process client import, export, or taxidermy paperwork. Client appoints taxidermist and agents. Estate supports practical field handover timing
complianceAndTrust.security: Gated access. Property referenced under Matlabas Protection Service in site copy

policiesRequiringManagementVerification: Exact drive time to Kruger or side trips
disallowedClaimsWithoutProof: Static public price list that overrides season and census
Zero boundary fencing (most SA estates use perimeter fencing)
Estate files SAPS or trophy export paperwork on behalf of clients
Common Eland as offered quarry (removed from roster)

contact.enquiryMechanism: mailto prefilled body from on-site forms. No server-side booking API in current build
